_comment: VES eligibility statuses/reasons that set documents_requested to true on the IvcChampvaApplicant record. Matched case-insensitively. 'statuses' matches the raw VES status; 'reasons' matches the raw VES reason but only when the applicant's status is ineligible (so an ELIGIBLE row with the same reason text, e.g. AUTO-CALC OFF, is never flagged). Add new values here as VES introduces them — no code change required.
reasons: no medicare part a or letter of disallowance
no medicare part b or letter of disallowance
